# pcd_networking_qos_policy (Resource)

Manages a Neutron QoS policy in PCD. Attach it to networks or ports and add rules with `pcd_networking_qos_bandwidth_limit_rule`, `_dscp_marking_rule`, or `_minimum_bandwidth_rule`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_qos_policy" "example" {
  name        = "tf-example-qos"
  description = "QoS policy managed by Terraform"
  shared      = true
  tags        = ["terraform", "qos"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the QoS policy.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the QoS policy.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default policy for the project.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the policy is shared across all projects.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the policy.
- `tenant_id` (String) The owning project. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The QoS policy ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_qos_policy.example <qos_policy_id>
```
